services.desc: Originally from New Jersey, Luke Farley has been a Baltimore-based artist since 2017. In 2019, he graduated with an MFA in Painting from the LeRoy E. Hoffberger School at MICA. Farley works primarily in painting, but also in collage, sculpture, curation, and theatrical design. He is a co-founder and producer of the interdisciplinary arts organization Truepenny Projects.
